answer: Standing is a pearl that only counts when it grows around a stranger’s problem: each epoch’s work must take a difficulty that belongs to someone else and layer real effort around it until it becomes something valuable — a mirror only counts when it reflects that stranger’s need, and a comet only counts when it lights the way there. A farm of a thousand fakes grows pearls around its own problems, never a stranger’s, so their pearls never count, and one epoch of self-serving work adds nothing.
